mapper.sql: FROM DIARY D JOIN CONTENT_MASTER CM ON CM.CONTENT_ID = D.CONTENT_ID WHERE CM.IS_DELETED = 'N'

D.DIARY_ID AS ID, D.CONTENT_ID, CM.USER_ID, D.DIARY_DATE AS `DATE`, D.TITLE, D.CONTENT, D.MOOD, D.HEALTH, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.CREATED_AT) * 1000 AS CREATED_AT, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CM.UPDATED_AT) * 1000 AS UPDATED_AT, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM DIARY_COMMENT C WHERE C.DIARY_ID = D.DIARY_ID AND C.IS_DELETED = 'N') AS COMMENT_COUNT
